projectionRules.roles: Four complete bulk fields omitted with canonical identities. Long2 additionally has explicit field/row/metric projections: all joins and ShotProof kept, Shot selection by original indices/positive-funding keys/exact chronology, Facts wholly omitted with type counts; every timing/transport window retained in declared numeric columns. No silent row cap.
projectionRules.text: Full text retained except declared long-server-log line projection (first20/last30/all diagnostic matches); exact original indices/hash/counts preserved. Chunked if needed.
projectionRules.encoding: Deterministic compact UTF-8 JSON, Unicode retained, final newline; 128Ki-character lossless text chunks, <=1MiB encoded, contiguous byte ranges/full projection digest.
projectionRules.excluded: No game assets, binary/runtime files, Paths.txt/profiles, recordings or media copied.
